item.title: SMB 单位经济
item.summary: SMB 单位经济的控制点不是最低标价，而是把获客补贴、激活、留存净收入、基础设施成本、伙伴分成、支持成本和失败损失锁在同一 cohort。公开证据能证明低价、免费额度、按量计费、伙伴和分层支持这些机制存在，但没有玩家披露可比的 SMB CAC、ARPU、90/365 日留存与完全成本贡献。

synthesis.outlook_12_36m: 竞争将从低价、credits 和注册账户转向按获客路线拆分的 365 日 retained contribution；支持 attach、失败损失和大/小账户 mix 会成为能否规模化的关键证据。
synthesis.strategic_summary: SMB 单位经济的控制点不是最低标价，而是把获客补贴、激活、留存净收入、基础设施成本、伙伴分成、支持成本和失败损失锁在同一 cohort。公开证据能证明低价、免费额度、按量计费、伙伴和分层支持这些机制存在，但没有玩家披露可比的 SMB CAC、ARPU、90/365 日留存与完全成本贡献。
synthesis.why_now: AI credits、freemium 与按量入口继续降低试用门槛，支持和伙伴价格也越来越显式；同时 SME 云采用仍落后、成本可见性不足且低触达支持存在尾部失败，必须从用户数转向 retained contribution。
winner_conditions: support attach with bounded minutes and failure loss
small-account economics independent of enterprise mix

evidence.source_quote: Grow with us and make up to a 25% margin when you join the DigitalOcean Partner Pod
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Provides an explicit maximum channel-margin anchor that must be deducted from vendor contribution when a partner serves the account.

evidence.source_quote: For teams developing and testing with non-production workloads.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Exposes $24, $99 and $999 monthly support tiers and response-time/service segmentation, providing a service-cost monetization anchor.

evidence.source_quote: Basic Support is included for all AWS customers
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Exposes included basic support and paid support floors/percentage ladders, enabling an explicit service attach model without assuming realized mix.

evidence.source_quote: Move from prototype to production faster. Apply for up to $200,000 in AWS Activate Credits, with additional credits available for AI startups ready to scale.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Shows acquisition subsidy and segmentation by funding stage; credits are a promotional input, not CAC, retention or realized consumption.

evidence.source_quote: A recent global survey commissioned by Crayon and conducted by Sapio Research found that 94% of IT leaders are struggling to optimize cloud costs.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Commissioned survey signal limits claims that usage pricing is automatically predictable; population is broader than SMB and retained as a reported estimate.

evidence.source_quote: DigitalOcean Droplets are available at a variety of price points, starting from as low as $4 per month.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Shows a low-friction entry price and explicit add-on cost surface; entry price alone is not retained ARPU or contribution.

evidence.source_quote: This year, AWS SMB Competency Partners grew their SMB AWS business 35% more YoY as compared to a similar group of Partners without SMB Competency.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Vendor-reported comparison supports partner specialization as a growth mechanism but does not provide matched CAC, retention or contribution.

evidence.source_quote: Net Dollar Retention Rate (“NDR”) increased to 101% from 99% in the fourth quarter of 2024.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Discloses retention, gross margin and customer-mix signals for a developer/self-service cloud, while explicitly redefining away sub-$500 monthly users.

evidence.source_quote: The current annual price for the Partner Success Core Benefits program is $925 USD or its equivalent in local currency.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Prices a partner enablement package that includes five technical pre-sales/deployment hours and two cloud-support incidents, revealing a bounded service unit.

evidence.source_quote: Using Amazon SageMaker, Forethought improved availability and customer response times and reduced its ML costs by up to 80 percent.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Named startup production case connects a managed service to customer cost reduction and service scalability; it does not reveal AWS acquisition or gross profit.

evidence.source_quote: Many products include a free tier or included usage — you are only charged for usage that exceeds the included amount.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Defines the freemium-to-usage conversion mechanism and customer cost-visibility controls; it does not disclose conversion rate or CAC.

evidence.source_quote: In Q4, we closed our largest annual contract value deal ever—averaging $42.5 million per year
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Gross margin coexists with a very large enterprise contract, countering any inference that freemium entry proves SMB-level economics.

evidence.source_quote: We’re a small company, and we monitor our costs very closely. If we were to use AWS for everything, our costs would be around $55,000 more per month than they are with DigitalOcean.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Named production case gives a customer-reported monthly cloud-cost difference and a multi-cloud boundary; it is not an independently audited vendor-margin result.

evidence.source_quote: In 2025, 85% of large businesses bought cloud services, while only 52% of SMEs did so.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Independent adoption-gap baseline shows that broad product availability and low entry prices have not closed the SME cloud adoption gap.

evidence.source_quote: The pay-as-you-go pricing was also a game-changer, allowing them to get a full-scale application up and running for an incredibly low cost.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Named startup production case connects pay-as-you-go entry to reduced infrastructure management; no renewal or vendor contribution is disclosed.

evidence.source_quote: account locked out suddenly without any follow-up to my inquiries from customer service over 48+ hours
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Dated community incident signal exposes the failure-loss tail of low-touch support; it is not a representative reliability statistic.

evidence.source_quote: Achieving interoperability without fragility is the primary challenge
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Trade-media expert counterevidence: low partner spend or DIY lowers cash outlay but can shift integration, security and maintenance costs back to the SMB.
